Your project runs these commands with `make`. The `stewart` commands below run inside the container:
`make sh`, then `stewart …`, or `docker compose exec stewart stewart …` while Stewart runs in the background.

## make

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `make help` | Show this help |
| `make setup` | First run: pull the images, create .env, install dependencies, check the container |
| `make pull` | Pull the runtime images |
| `make env` | Create .env from .env.example with a fresh control token, unless it exists |
| `make install` | composer install |
| `make update` | composer update |
| `make upgrade` | Move to another Stewart release line, then pull its images and install it [VERSION=2.0] |
| `make sh` | Shell in the development container |
| `make doctor` | Check the container, the settings, and the connections to Home Assistant and the store |
| `make app` | Create an app in apps/ and its test in tests/ [NAME=PorchLight] |
| `make generate` | Write typed entity and service classes from Home Assistant into generated/ [ARGS=--allow-shrink] |
| `make run` | Run in the foreground [ONLY="hello porch" to run only those apps, TRACE=hello to trace one, DRY_RUN=1 to send no service calls] |
| `make watch` | Run in the foreground and reload after every saved change [ONLY="hello porch", TRACE=hello, DRY_RUN=1] |
| `make debug` | Run in the foreground with Xdebug [ONLY="hello porch", TRACE=hello] |
| `make config` | Show the effective config, secrets masked |
| `make config-reference` | Show every supported config option |
| `make check` | Check that the configuration loads and every app can be built, and list the apps |
| `make test` | Run the tests |
| `make stan` | Static analysis |
| `make up` | Start the daemon in the background |
| `make down` | Stop everything |
| `make deploy` | Pull, install and check the latest commit, then restart; a failed check keeps the running daemon |
| `make logs` | Follow the daemon logs |
| `make status` | One-shot status of the running daemon |
| `make app-pause` | Pause an app of the running daemon [APP=porch-light] |
| `make app-resume` | Resume a paused app [APP=porch-light] |
| `make app-reset` | Forget a stored pause or resume, so stewart.yaml decides again [APP=porch-light] |
| `make worker-restart` | Restart a worker of the running daemon [WORKER=0] |
| `make reload` | Check the project, then restart every worker on the current code; the Home Assistant session stays up |

## stewart

### app:pause

Pause one app: it stays loaded but skips deliveries and schedules until resumed

```
stewart app:pause [options] [--] <app>
```

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `app` | The automation ID, as shown by stewart status |

| Option | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-c, --config=…` | Path to stewart.yaml; defaults to stewart.yaml in the project root |  |
| `--address=…` | Where the daemon listens, such as unix://var/run/stewart.sock or tcp://host:port; defaults to control.listen |  |
| `--token=…` | The control token; defaults to control.token, usually STEWART_CONTROL__TOKEN |  |
| `--timeout=…` | How long to wait for the daemon, like 5s | `5s` |

### app:reset

Forget the stored pause or resume of one app, so its config decides again

```
stewart app:reset [options] [--] <app>
```

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `app` | The automation ID, as shown by stewart status |

| Option | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-c, --config=…` | Path to stewart.yaml; defaults to stewart.yaml in the project root |  |
| `--address=…` | Where the daemon listens, such as unix://var/run/stewart.sock or tcp://host:port; defaults to control.listen |  |
| `--token=…` | The control token; defaults to control.token, usually STEWART_CONTROL__TOKEN |  |
| `--timeout=…` | How long to wait for the daemon, like 5s | `5s` |

| `--token=…` | The control token; defaults to control.token, usually STEWART_CONTROL__TOKEN |  |
| `--timeout=…` | How long to wait for the daemon, like 5s | `5s` |

### check

Check that the configuration loads and every app can be built

```
stewart check [options]
```

| Option | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-c, --config=…` | Path to stewart.yaml; defaults to stewart.yaml in the project root |  |

### config:dump

Show the effective configuration after the environment is applied

```
stewart config:dump [options]
```

| Option | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-c, --config=…` | Path to stewart.yaml; defaults to stewart.yaml in the project root |  |
| `--show-secrets` | Print credentials instead of masking them |  |

### config:reference

Show every supported option with its type and default

```
stewart config:reference
```

### doctor

Check that this PHP can run Stewart, and that it reaches Home Assistant and the store

```
stewart doctor [options]
```

| Option | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-c, --config=…` | Path to stewart.yaml; defaults to stewart.yaml in the project root |  |
| `--offline` | Check only this container, not the settings and connections |  |

### generate

Write typed entity and service classes from your Home Assistant

```
stewart generate [options]
```

| Option | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-c, --config=…` | Path to stewart.yaml; defaults to stewart.yaml in the project root |  |
| `--snapshot-in=…` | Generate from this file instead of connecting |  |
| `--snapshot-out=…` | Write what was read to this file |  |
| `--check` | Report what would change and fail if anything would |  |
| `--allow-shrink` | Write even if that deletes more than half of the generated files |  |

### make:app

Create an app in apps/ and its test in tests/

```
stewart make:app [options] [--] <name>
```

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `name` | The class name, such as PorchLight |

| Option | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--id=…` | The automation ID; derived from the name when left out, such as porch-light |  |

### reload

Check the project, then restart every worker on the current code, keeping the Home Assistant session

```
stewart reload [options]
```

| Option | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-c, --config=…` | Path to stewart.yaml; defaults to stewart.yaml in the project root |  |
| `--address=…` | Where the daemon listens, such as unix://var/run/stewart.sock or tcp://host:port; defaults to control.listen |  |
| `--token=…` | The control token; defaults to control.token, usually STEWART_CONTROL__TOKEN |  |
| `--timeout=…` | How long to wait for the daemon, like 5s | `5s` |

### run

Run the Stewart daemon

```
stewart run [options]
```

| Option | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-c, --config=…` | Path to stewart.yaml; defaults to stewart.yaml in the project root |  |
| `-l, --log-level=…` | debug\|info\|notice\|warning\|error |  |
| `--json-logs` | Emit logs as JSON |  |
| `--only=…` | Run only this automation, even if disabled; repeat for more |  |
| `--trace=…` | Log TRACE lines for this automation at any log level; repeat for more |  |
| `--watch` | Reload after every saved change to the apps, services.php or stewart.yaml |  |

### status

Show what the running daemon is doing, once

```
stewart status [options]
```

| Option | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-c, --config=…` | Path to stewart.yaml; defaults to stewart.yaml in the project root |  |
| `--address=…` | Where the daemon listens, such as unix://var/run/stewart.sock or tcp://host:port; defaults to control.listen |  |
| `--token=…` | The control token; defaults to control.token, usually STEWART_CONTROL__TOKEN |  |
| `--timeout=…` | How long to wait for the daemon, like 5s | `5s` |
| `--json` | Print the snapshot as the wire JSON instead of tables |  |
| `--probe=…` | liveness or readiness: print one line and exit 0 or 1, for health checks |  |

### worker:restart

Restart one worker with a fresh crash budget, also after it was quarantined

```
stewart worker:restart [options] [--] <worker>
```

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `worker` | The worker number, as shown by stewart status |

| Option | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-c, --config=…` | Path to stewart.yaml; defaults to stewart.yaml in the project root |  |
| `--address=…` | Where the daemon listens, such as unix://var/run/stewart.sock or tcp://host:port; defaults to control.listen |  |
| `--token=…` | The control token; defaults to control.token, usually STEWART_CONTROL__TOKEN |  |
| `--timeout=…` | How long to wait for the daemon, like 5s | `5s` |
